statement:
The record indicates that invoice 88412 was already paid in full on 3 September under reference PAY-2291 despite currently showing a status of unpaid and due.
Invoice 88412 from Atlas Supply has been placed on hold because the payment history shows it was already paid in full on September 3 (reference PAY-2291).
judge_text:
WRONG
The answer asserts the "unpaid, due" status contradicts the record's own payment history ("already paid in full on September 3 (reference PAY-2291)") and holds payment rather than merely suggesting verification.
[judge: anthropic/claude-opus-5]
